title: Weekly Leadership Staff
summary: Discussion covered Q2 performance, US enterprise, AI Copilot, Hiring. The team reached 3 clear decision(s) and assigned follow-up work.
decisions: Keep US enterprise as the top commercial priority for Q3
Limit the AI roadmap to meeting summaries and workflow recommendations

action_items.task: Keep US enterprise as the top commercial priority for Q3
Limit the AI roadmap to meeting summaries and workflow recommendations

transcript.speaker: Aditi Rao
transcript.text: Let's focus today's discussion on Q2 performance, US enterprise, AI Copilot.

transcript.speaker: Rohan Mehta
transcript.text: From the platform side, we can support this, but we should define the technical boundary clearly.

transcript.speaker: Arjun Malhotra
transcript.text: The product problem is not lack of ideas. It is choosing the smallest set that creates repeat value.

transcript.speaker: Meera Iyer
transcript.text: The market signal is consistent across the larger deals, especially in the US enterprise segment.

transcript.speaker: Nisha Kapoor
transcript.text: The customer pattern matters more than the loudest individual request. We should act on repeat behavior.

transcript.speaker: Kabir Shah
transcript.text: I am comfortable with the investment if we can see the unit economics and the downside case.

transcript.speaker: Tara Menon
transcript.text: The message will work better if we can show proof rather than another list of features.

transcript.speaker: Aditi Rao
transcript.text: My recommendation is that we keep US enterprise as the top commercial priority for Q3.

transcript.speaker: Rohan Mehta
transcript.text: My recommendation is that we limit the AI roadmap to meeting summaries and workflow recommendations.

transcript.speaker: Arjun Malhotra
transcript.text: My recommendation is that we freeze non-critical hiring until September.

transcript.speaker: Aditi Rao
transcript.text: Okay, we are aligned on freeze non-critical hiring until september. Let's capture owners and move.
